rationale: Genome-wide oxaliplatin screens in colorectal cancer lines (MAGeCK count tables deposited per screen; the count_normalized files are ignored). One library per condition, so BARCS uses the no-replicate path (overdispersion pooled over the non-targeting guides); calls are screening-level. The paper compares day-20 oxaliplatin with day-20 untreated cells; SLC43A1 should be enriched in knockout and depleted in activation screens. RKO Calabrese activation screen, oxaliplatin vs untreated at day 20; SLC43A1 activation should be depleted. Controls are the NO-TARGET guides.
